intent.statement: Implement Task 2 from 0_Planning/Multilingual_Local_Model_Speech_Blocks_Plan.md: create a deterministic Unicode-aware multilingual source span builder before Speech Blocks model calls, with stable ordered span IDs, exact text/whitespace preservation, language-neutral dialogue/narration/attribution/mixed candidates, paragraph boundary safety, and coverage for Romanian, French, German, Russian, Japanese, Chinese/CJK, and mixed narration-dialogue cases.

examples: A chunk segment exposes source_spans s001, s002, ... and model selections must reference only those IDs.
spec_items.statement: For narrator-and-character Speech Blocks generation, AudioMancer shall build ordered source spans with stable IDs before model calls and attach them to the active chunk or AI-budget segment payload.

examples: Romanian/French/Russian guillemets, Romanian/Russian dash-led dialogue, German quote styles, English straight or curly quotes, and CJK/fullwidth quotation marks are classified consistently.
spec_items.statement: The source span builder shall classify spans as dialogue_candidate, narration_candidate, attribution_candidate, or mixed_candidate using Unicode dialogue punctuation and paragraph structure rather than English-only speech verbs.
Built source spans shall reconstruct exactly to the active source text, preserving whitespace, punctuation, paragraph order, and contiguous coverage without merging across paragraph boundaries.
spec_items.threshold: Joining source_spans[*].text for one active chunk or AI-budget segment must equal that payload text byte-for-byte at Python string level.
